description: Defines template functions 'vol2col' and 'col2vol' for volumetric data transformations used in neural network operations, specifically for converting volumetric data to column format and vice versa.

methods.name: vol2col
methods.description: Transforms volumetric data into column format for convolution operations.

methods.name: col2vol
methods.description: Reconstructs volumetric data from column format.
